description: Amtliche Straßenkarte Baden-Württemberg 1:200 000 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by metadaten.geoportal-bw.de. The official road map of Baden-Württemberg 1:200 000 (ASK200) presents selected contents of the DLM250, the DLM50 and technical data of the Road Construction Administration Baden-Württemberg. The corresponding comparable data bases are presented in neighbouring countries (France: BD CARTO(r), Switzerland: VECTOR200). The thematic focus is on the representation of road transport (classified road network). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Official road map Baden-Württemberg 1:200 000" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS, open data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
